nodes.goal:
Add job cancellation, automatic retries for failed jobs, and recovery after a process restart to this job runner. Expose cancellation and retry status through the REST API and show them on the web dashboard. Follow the behaviour specified in SPEC.md.

Work through the following steps in order; each step lists its goal and files.

Step 1 of 7: Contract: states, job fields, errors, cancel and backoff [A]
This is the contract every other sub-task builds on; follow SPEC.md for names, types, and defaults. Give each new name a docstring. In jobrunner/models.py add JobStatus.CANCELLED (final) and the Job fields attempts=0, max_attempts=3, next_run_at=0.0, last_error=None, cancel_requested=False, included in Job.to_dict. In jobrunner/errors.py add TransientError and InvalidTransition. In jobrunner/store.py fill the new Job fields from the existing progress columns and make claim add 1 to attempts. In jobrunner/retry.py add the complete helper backoff_delay(base_delay, failures) = base_delay * 2 ** (failures - 1) (leave decide unchanged). Create jobrunner/cancellation.py with request_cancel(store, job_id) -> Job: a default that cancels PENDING jobs, raises InvalidTransition for final jobs and JobNotFound for unknown ids; add Runner.cancel delegating to it. Write tests/test_contract.py.
Modify: jobrunner/models.py, jobrunner/errors.py, jobrunner/store.py, jobrunner/retry.py, jobrunner/runner.py
Create: jobrunner/cancellation.py
Tests to write: tests/test_contract.py

Step 2 of 7: Retry policy and due-time scheduling [R]
Implement SPEC.md 'Retries' in jobrunner/retry.py decide: a TransientError sends the job back to PENDING with next_run_at = now + backoff_delay(base_delay, job.attempts) while job.attempts < job.max_attempts, otherwise FAILED; any other exception is FAILED at once; the outcome carries the error message. In jobrunner/scheduler.py make pick_next return only PENDING jobs with next_run_at <= now, earliest next_run_at first, then oldest. Write tests/test_retry_policy.py.
Modify: jobrunner/retry.py, jobrunner/scheduler.py
Tests to write: tests/test_retry_policy.py

Step 3 of 7: Restart recovery [S]
Implement SPEC.md 'Restart recovery' in jobrunner/recovery.py recover, which Runner.__init__ already calls: every RUNNING job becomes CANCELLED if cancel_requested is set; otherwise the interruption counts as a failure: PENDING with next_run_at = now + backoff_delay(base_delay, attempts) and a last_error saying it was interrupted while attempts < max_attempts, else FAILED. Use JobStore.update_progress. Write tests/test_restart_recovery.py.
Modify: jobrunner/recovery.py
Tests to write: tests/test_restart_recovery.py

Step 4 of 7: Cancellation of running jobs [D]
Complete SPEC.md 'Cancellation' without touching run_once: in jobrunner/cancellation.py request_cancel sets cancel_requested on a RUNNING job; in jobrunner/store.py JobStore.finish turns a job whose cancel_requested is set into CANCELLED, discarding the result and any retry. Write tests/test_cancel.py.
Modify: jobrunner/cancellation.py, jobrunner/store.py
Tests to write: tests/test_cancel.py

Step 5 of 7: REST API for cancellation and retry status [E]
Extend jobrunner/api.py as SPEC.md 'REST API' requires: add POST /jobs/<id>/cancel (200 with the job, 404 for an unknown id, 409 when Runner.cancel raises InvalidTransition) and make sure job JSON (Job.to_dict) includes attempts, max_attempts, next_run_at, last_error, and cancel_requested. Keep the existing routes and error format. Write tests/test_api_status.py covering the new route and fields.
Modify: jobrunner/api.py
Tests to write: tests/test_api_status.py

Step 6 of 7: Dashboard columns and cancel form [F]
Change jobrunner/dashboard.py render_jobs as SPEC.md 'Dashboard' requires: columns ID, Kind, Status, Attempts (attempts/max_attempts), Next retry (next_run_at with one decimal for a PENDING job with attempts > 0, otherwise '-'), and Actions (the cancel form for PENDING and RUNNING jobs, empty otherwise). Keep HTML escaping. Write tests/test_dashboard_status.py.
Modify: jobrunner/dashboard.py
Tests to write: tests/test_dashboard_status.py

Step 7 of 7: Integration and end-to-end tests [G]
Write tests/test_end_to_end.py exercising SPEC.md end to end through the REST API and the dashboard: flaky jobs retried to success, cancellation of pending and running jobs, and a restart (a new JobStore and Runner on the same database file) recovering waiting and interrupted jobs. Fix any mismatch between modules that these tests reveal.
Modify: jobrunner/store.py, jobrunner/runner.py, jobrunner/retry.py, jobrunner/scheduler.py, jobrunner/recovery.py, jobrunner/cancellation.py, jobrunner/api.py, jobrunner/dashboard.py
Tests to write: tests/test_end_to_end.py
